chunks: May he be accursed, how he planned!
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Faqutila kayfa qaddar' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific fate of the disbelievers who underestimated the power of the Divine, serving as a warning against relying on worldly calculations over spiritual reality. The phrase 'how he estimated' (kayfa qaddara) emphasizes the inadequacy of human intellect when facing the absolute decree of Allah, a theme central to the concept of divine justice in the Hereafter.
